# T-4: Guard acceptance decisions

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Derive acceptance routing from requirement outcomes and enforce an explicit approval boundary for notVerifiable risk or abort decisions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- notMet has routing precedence and promotes impl-triage.
- notVerifiable reaches acceptance-decision only when no notMet judgment exists.
- The decision action reports requires_approval=true.
- No autoApprove, default, omitted-choice, or non-interactive path selects accept_risk_and_continue or abort.

## Implementation Notes
Keep acceptance-decision as the explicit mutation surface. Make unsafe choices impossible without an explicit validated choice rather than relying only on prompt text.

## Test Strategy
Unit and CLI tests cover routing precedence, approval metadata, omitted input, autoApprove=true, explicit repair, explicit risk acceptance, and explicit abort.
